rows: First job or first search
Long days of learning the basics of the job. Very little spare energy after work.
One role skill you can show, written English for email and reports, spreadsheets.
Early career, roughly the first few years
You own tasks now, but someone else sets the priorities.
Data and reporting on your own work, one tool at real depth, clear updates to your manager.
Mid career, roughly five to ten years in
Meetings, people, deadlines. Learning time comes from evenings and weekends.
Stakeholder handling, a multiplier skill (sales sense, analytics, AI-assisted workflow design), people leadership if it suits you.
Returning after a break
Fragmented time. Short, repeatable study windows.
One refreshed core skill, current tool fluency, and a clear one-line story for the gap.
First job or first search
Collecting course certificates before one finished sample exists.
One project, internship task or sample that a stranger can open in two minutes.
Early career, roughly the first few years
Switching tools every few months and never getting deep in one.
A before-and-after: what you changed, what improved, how you know.
Mid career, roughly five to ten years in
Treating a management title as the only way up when a specialist or advisory path fits you better.
A process win, a team result or a client outcome you can describe with numbers.
Returning after a break
Trying to rebuild everything at once and burning out in the first stretch.
One small paid or volunteer piece of work done recently, plus an updated profile.

blocks.heading: Free First: the Learning Routes Worth Using
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Free first: the learning routes worth using

rows: Skill India Digital Hub
Many courses are listed free. Check the price on each course page.
Sampling a skill at no cost, and joining training, assessment, certification and job links in one place. The hub was launched on 13 September 2023.
SWAYAM and NPTEL
Course content is free. A certificate needs a proctored exam, which carries a fee.
University-level material. In a July 2026 notice, UGC told institutions they may let students take up to 40% of a semester's courses through SWAYAM, so credit is now more realistic.
AICTE National Internship Portal
Free to register. Stipends are shown upfront.
Verified internships with QR-verifiable certificates, and credits that can go into the Academic Bank of Credits.
YouTube, official documentation, open courseware
Free
Often more current than a syllabus, especially for tools that change fast.
Paid course, batch or mentor
Varies widely. Compare it against the free options first.
Worth paying for when it adds what free material cannot: expert feedback on your own work, accountability, live practice.
Skill India Digital Hub

Scheme results vary. Government data shows only 5.0% of people aged 15 to 29 had formal vocational or technical training in 2025, and independent analysts have questioned placement figures for earlier PMKVY rounds. Ask where past learners actually ended up.
SWAYAM and NPTEL
Your own college decides which courses count. NPTEL asks for at least 40 out of 100 in both the assignment average and the final exam. Watching lectures is not the same as building something.
AICTE National Internship Portal
It serves students of AICTE, UGC and IGNOU institutions. Working professionals will need a different route to real work.
YouTube, official documentation, open courseware
No feedback and no deadline. Pair it with a small project so you are not just watching.
Paid course, batch or mentor
A certificate alone rarely changes a shortlist. Ask for the project you will finish, refund terms, and how recent the material is.

blocks.heading: How to Judge a Career Development Course
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: How to judge a career development course

rows: Who teaches it, and what have they done recently?
Current practice changes faster than a syllabus.
Only a brand name, no named instructor with recent work.
When was it last updated?
A tool-based course can be out of date within a year or two.
No update date, or screenshots from old versions of the tool.
What will you have built by the end?
A project is the proof. A completion badge is not.
Only quizzes, or a "capstone" that is a tutorial clone.
Does someone give feedback on your own work?
This is the main thing a paid course can add over free material.
No reviewer, no live session, no way to ask a question.
What does the certificate need, and does anyone in your field ask for it?
NPTEL, for example, needs at least 40 out of 100 in both assignments and the proctored exam.
A ranking of "certificates employers value most" with no published survey behind it.
What are the refund terms and total cost?
Keep any single course within your yearly learning budget, as the money section below explains.
Pressure to pay today, or a loan to fund the course.
